grade_reason: Seven web searches found no statement by Melissa Bean about AI since 1 January 2025, and none about catastrophic AI risk.
notes: All 7 searches ran; none was refused. Search results describe her as the Democratic nominee for Illinois's 8th District who served that seat from 2005 to 2011 (seen in search summaries only, not on a page opened this session). She was not in the House in 2025-2026, so she could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, and she did not sign the House letters. Not a statement but possibly relevant to a reviewer: search summaries say AI-industry and crypto PACs spent money supporting her (a Prospect article, https://prospect.org/2026/02/20/aipac-ai-pacs-crypto-midterms-congress-chicago/, reports a PAC called Think Big spent over $1 million on Jackson and Bean; a spending tracker, https://influence.citationneeded.news/2026/elections/IL-H-08, lists $1.14M from AI PACs, apparently in other races for this seat); neither page was opened, and campaign money is level D under the rubric anyway. Candidate questionnaires from WTTW (https://news.wttw.com/node/55084, fetch returned 403) and the Daily Herald (https://www.dailyherald.com/?p=1358766, fetch returned an empty page) could not be read; search summaries of them mention Congress's role, Social Security, immigration, ethics reform and transportation but not AI. Her campaign site was not found: melissabean.com returned an empty page. A July 2026 Chicago Sun-Times article on Illinois Democrats and AI was opened and does not mention her. Search was not exhaustive for local debates or interviews.
